name: CalorieNinjas
tagline: Nutrition data API for food text and image lookups
description: CalorieNinjas provides nutrition facts for foods and recipes from natural-language queries and optional image analysis. Developers typically use it to estimate calories, macros, and micronutrients for apps, meal trackers, and fitness tools.

auth.details: API key via X-Api-Key header; self-serve signup on calorieninjas.com

use_cases: get nutrition facts for a food text query
estimate calories and macros for a meal description
